ruling_on_a_second_edgar_full_index_vint.question: Is fetching a SECOND EDGAR full-index vintage worth doing now, given the separation from the 2026-08-16 snapshot would currently be only about 5 weeks?
ruling_on_a_second_edgar_full_index_vint.ruling: CAPTURE YES, ANALYSE NO, AND R70_C1 IS NOT REOPENED BY IT.
ruling_on_a_second_edgar_full_index_vint.analysis_now_is_worthless_because: The value of first-appearance differencing scales with the separation relative to the release lag, and R70 measured that lag directly: UPLOAD rows per quarter collapse monotonically toward the snapshot - 2009q1 3,421; 2015q1 2,494; 2020q1 1,406; 2026q2 351. That right-censoring decays over YEARS, so the censoring horizon is years, not weeks. A 5-to-6 week baseline bounds the release instant only for documents that first appear inside those 5-6 weeks, which is a thin and NON-RANDOM slice - precisely the shortest-lag releases. Imputing a panel-wide release lag from that slice is selection on the dependent variable and would produce a confident wrong answer instead of an honest unknown.
ruling_on_a_second_edgar_full_index_vint.capture_now_is_still_right_because: The marginal cost is one HTTP fetch per quarterly index and a few MB. The marginal OPTION value is real and strictly decaying: every month not captured is a month of separation that can never be bought back, and that irreversibility is exactly what made R70_C1 unrecoverable. It is the same discipline as a forward challenger - converting an unrecoverable historical instant into a prospectively recoverable one - except that it costs no multiple-testing budget and starts no forward clock.
conditions: Store the vintage DATED and IMMUTABLE beside the 2026-08-16 snapshot with a manifest recording the fetch instant. Do NOT overwrite the existing snapshot: that would destroy the only baseline and be worse than not fetching at all.
No pre-registration, no feature, no signal and no hypothesis is attached to the capture.
Earliest review of R70_C1 is at a separation of at least TWO QUARTERS, i.e. not before roughly 2027-03. Until then R70_C1 stays DATA_BLOCKED and is not re-ruled.
The CIK identity bridge must be repaired independently - a second vintage does nothing about the 108-of-339 delisted-member resolution failure.

ruling_on_a_second_edgar_full_index_vint.priority: Rank 4 of 6. It is cheap and time-sensitive, but it cannot produce an answer this year, whereas ranks 1-3 can produce answers this week.

highest_value_free_unblocking_action.cost: FREE, owned data, doable now, ZERO multiple-testing budget
highest_value_free_unblocking_action.why_it_beats_every_alternative: It is the shared HARD blocker of every candidate equity information family in this estate - R70_C1 comment letters, R71_C1 Form 144, R71_C2 Form 4, and any FINRA ticker join - and it cannot be substituted. R70 measured the defect at 108 of 339 delisted S&P ever-members failing to resolve, a 31.9% failure rate concentrated on exactly the names that carry the survivorship signal. Without it, no new equity information family can ever be certified PIT-safe. The reason it is FREE is the load-bearing observation: the owned Form 4 bulk store is itself vintage-stamped raw material for the bridge, so unlike SEC company_tickers.json - a current-view snapshot with the same single-vintage disease that killed R70_C1 - it can resolve a name AT THE DATE it was still trading.
highest_value_free_unblocking_action.what_it_does_not_do: It does not make any cell registrable by itself. It moves three blocked cells from 'blocked by an unfixable identity defect' to 'blocked by their own specific, measurable question'.

spawn_ruling.honest_note_on_the_gate: The FIRST spawn-plan run on this spec reported data_certified=true and spawned only the director, because the spec had no requires block and alpha_agent.agents_v2.briefs then keeps the estate-wide answer ('a campaign that names nothing keeps the estate-wide answer', briefs.py line 151). That was an artifact of an UNDECLARED requirement, not a fact about R71. I declared the five dataset certifications R71's cells actually need; the gate then reported data_certified=false with all five in substrate_missing and flipped data-foundation-agent to SPAWN. I did not widen the gate - I stopped under-declaring to it.

what_would_reopen_each_cell.R71_C1: A certified edgar_form144_notional_v1 dataset: measured 71-quarter row depth, a measured document-body extraction rate for issuer/seller/share count, and the PIT CIK<->ticker bridge. If only a COUNT feature proves extractable, the cell is REFUSED, not reopened.
what_would_reopen_each_cell.R71_C2: An OPERATOR ANSWER to the scope question escalated at INFORMATION_FRONTIER_AUDIT.json line 305, plus a measured AFF10B5ONE coverage-by-year table and a frozen-threshold orthogonality correlation against the closed all-transactions feature. Registrable then against the PARENT denominator of 19, never a fresh key.
what_would_reopen_each_cell.R71_C3: 12+ months of prospectively captured, dated NOAA forecast vintages. There is no historical shortcut and the current archive is revised.
what_would_reopen_each_cell.R71_C4: NOTHING from futures prices. Only genuinely non-price terms-of-trade information (national export/import price indices with vintages), which is not owned. Do not re-propose.
what_would_reopen_each_cell.R71_C5: NOTHING. An inventory-surprise mechanism under a new agency's name is a replication. Do not re-propose.
what_would_reopen_each_cell.R71_C6: A certified dated halt history. If the source is genuinely prospective-only, record it as PROSPECTIVE_ONLY in the census so it is never proposed as a backtest again. The per-cell net cost budget must also be fixed and pinned BEFORE this cell registers.

honest_conclusion: NO NEW ALPHA AXIS IS OPEN ON CERTIFIED DATA TODAY. That is the literal answer and I am not softening it. It is not the same as 'no axis exists': two never-tested, genuinely non-price information families - Rule 144 pre-announced supply and the Form 4 10b5-1 partition - sit on data that is ALREADY ON DISK with exact filing dates, and each is blocked by work that is free and takes days, not by a missing dataset purchase. One of the two additionally needs a single human answer that has been outstanding since R60. The estate's deeper problem is not idea supply: it is that 8 forward challengers have produced 0 matured observations and 0 effective independent observations, so nothing registered so far can be judged at all. Registering a 9th is not progress. Letting the 8 run, and spending this cycle on free data certification instead of on lockbox looks, is.
